test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Coal and petroleum have their own advantages and disadvantages. Three of the statements regarding coal and petroleum are similar. Choose the one that is dissimilar.

options.text: Used to generate electricity in thermal plants and are cost effective
When burnt produce CO2, which causes global warming
When burnt produce oxides of N and S that are poisonous and cause acid rain
When burnt in insufficient O2 produce carbon monoxide, which is a poisonous gas

solution:
The correct answer is **__Used to generate electricity in thermal plants and are cost effective__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fossil Fuel:**

 
 
• There are three major types of fossil fuels, they are** coal, petroleum and natural gas.**
 
• Coal is a hard substance which is black in colour and composed of **carbon, hydrogen, nitrogen, oxygen and sulphur.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Advantages of Fossil Fuel**

 
 
• Fossil fuels **have the ability to create a huge amount of electricity at a single location.**
 
• Moreover, they are found easily and also cost-effective.
 
• Further, we can easily transport oil and gas through pipelines.
 
• Over time, they have become safer. Besides, most of our infrastructure is designed to operate through the use of fossil fuels.
 
• Finally, even though it is a finite resource, it is available in abundance.
 
 
 
• **Disadvantages of Fossil Fuel**
 
 
• They emit carbon dioxide, a major greenhouse gas, on burning, which is also a major source of pollution and **contributes to global warming.**
 
• When we burn coal and oil, it **releases sulfur dioxide** that can cause breathing problems and **acid rain**.
 
• Most importantly, we cannot replace them.
 
• Further, when we burn them, they make the** environment more acidic due release of nitrogen and sulphur**.
 
• Being nonrenewable energy resources, their limited supply means we will run out eventually.
 
• Moreover, harvesting them results in fatal diseases like coal miners suffer from** Black Lung Disease** sometimes and natural gas drillers are exposed to chemicals which is also dangerous health-wise.
